CRTC.name: Create Certificate
CRTC.definition: Creation of an X.509 certificate with the public key and the information of the owner of the asymmetric key provided by the requestor.

CRTR.name: Renew Cerificate
CRTR.definition: Renewal of an X.509 certificate, protected by the certificate to renew.

CRTK.name: Revoke Certificate
CRTK.definition: Revocation of an active X.509 certificate.

WLSR.name: Remove White List
WLSR.definition: Remove a POI from the white list of the terminal manager.

WLSA.name: Add White List
WLSA.definition: Add a POI in the white list of the terminal manager.
